articles.summary: Presentations will feature encore Phase 1 data highlighting the mechanism of action, redosing potential, and early C-peptide response associated with SAB-142, a fully human multi-specific ATG for Stage 3 type 1 diabetes MIAMI, Oct. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- SAB Biotherapeutics, Inc.
articles.title: SAB BIO to Present SAB-142 Data at the Inaugural Breakthrough T1D Clinical & Research Congress
